extracted.stage: Ongoing matrimonial proceedings, hearing listed, pre-settlement/trial
extracted.summary: A solicitor at Beckford Solicitors LLP is enquiring about £17,500 to fund her client's representation in ongoing matrimonial proceedings where the matrimonial pot is around £280,000 and a hearing is listed in 28 days.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry to Lodestar Legal Finance; we have logged the details of your client's matter and the hearing listed on 25 September. To progress our review we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and court, the names of the parties for conflict checks, a breakdown of the costs the £17,500 is intended to cover, and supporting evidence of the assets in dispute such as a Form E or asset schedule. We would also be grateful for confirmation of your client's instructions and contact details. Please note this is an acknowledgement only and does not indicate any decision on funding. A member of the team will be in touch once the information has been received and reviewed.
